# Allowlist for validation/scan_numbers.py: known false positives only (for example a digit run inside a hash).
# One sha256 hex digest per line of the 10 matched digits (separators and a leading country code 1 removed), never
# the digits themselves:  printf %s '<10 digits>' | shasum -a 256
# A real phone number never goes here: remove it from the files, tell the team lead, and rotate whatever it exposes.
# Fictional 555-exchange numbers need no entry; the scanner ignores them.
